title: Scalar contractible tests detect the actual open unit for lisse internal modules
statement:
Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and put $W=X[1/f]$. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. On every small pro-etale site $Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $\Lambda_Z=p_Z^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use internal $\Lambda_Z$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Use ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived categories, with direct image computed by K-injective total derived functors of the internal-module direct image and with its actual derived adjunction unit [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Derived sections of underlying abelian sheaves are computed by K-injectives [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology].

Assume that for every affine pro-etale $v:V\to X$ which is weakly contractible as an object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible], the actual scalar restriction
$$R\Gamma(V,\Lambda_V[0])\longrightarrow R\Gamma(V\times_XW,\Lambda_{V\times_XW}[0])$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathbf{Ab})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Weak contractibility here means that evaluation on $V$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets on the full site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to a surjection.

Then for every affine pro-etale $a:X'\to X$, every lisse $\Lambda_{X'}$-module $N$ (locally a finite direct sum of copies of $\Lambda_{X'}$ on a pro-etale covering, with ranks allowed to vary) [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], and $j':W\times_XX'\hookrightarrow X'$, the actual derived adjunction unit
$$N[0]\longrightarrow Rj'_*j'^*N[0]$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_{X'}})$. The coefficient ring is arbitrary, and no global trivialization, finite coefficient field, connectedness, or Noetherian assumption is required. Rank zero, empty schemes and identity opens are included.

proof.text: Whisker the actual adjunction unit by the degree-zero single functor. Both endpoint functors are additive, hence preserve finite coproducts. Its component on a finite biproduct of the regular module is invertible by the colimit comparison lemma. Naturality transports this along the given finite-free trivialization, including the empty biproduct of rank zero.

Statement: unchanged and true. Tests: f invertible gives the identity unit; f=0 forces Λ(V)=0 on every test, so N=0; rank 0, empty X' and varying ranks all hold. Steps 1-2 use the internal/sectionwise transport with unit and counit, the alpha iso, slice exactness and the K-flat/exact adjunction transport (η^P=G(c^{-1})η^A), so u=j'_*s∘η^ord represents the actual unit. Steps 3-4: absolute contractible-basis tests inside trivializing charts (T=V×_X W agrees with the hypothesis's T), and the sectionwise unit is restriction. Step 5: I checked myself that u(V) is the actual derived restriction: with a homotopy-unique I|_T→J'|_T over N, Γ(T,a)∘u(V) equals the abelian restriction. det-pe-wc-sections-exact applies on V_proet because w-contractibility is a property of the ring. Steps 6-8: finite sums, cone cohomology vanishing on the tests, separatedness. New node lem-sfb-ringed-sections-forget-abelian: matches Stacks 0D6J(2) (sites-cohomology.tex 4453-4482) with the Γ(U,I)→Γ(U,J) representative; statement-only, derived form, searched. It is not a duplicate of the per-degree single-module lem-weil-pbc-ringed-site-module-abelian-evaluation-comparison or the D^+ constant-ring lem-pe-left-module-derived-evaluation-forget, which the report missed; maintainer note only. The nine generic tool_uses are accepted. No SGA, no repair note, no cycle seen.
